```plato

    // The magnitude of self carrying the sign of y. A y of -0.0 reads as
    // non-negative here, where IEEE copysign reads it as negative.
    CopySign(self: Number, y: Number): Number
        => 0.0 <= y ? self.Abs : -self.Abs;
```
